user_questions.question: Your requirement contradicts itself: deleting storefronts removes them and their cascade children (Review__c, Menu__c, Storefront_Hours_of_Operation__c, Event_Storefront__c), so history cannot then be kept 7 years; also 0 of 21 storefronts are Inactive today. (1) Do you want (a) no deletion: keep Inactive storefronts as archived records and hide them from default list views [recommended], (b) export to external archive then delete, or (c) delete and accept the loss? (2) For 7-year history, Field Audit Trail add-on [recommended] or a custom archive (standard history keeps 18-24 months)? (3) Track all trackable business fields [recommended] or a subset?
user_questions.simulated_answer: (1) Don't delete — archive: keep records, hide from default list views. (2) and (3): No preference; use your recommended default.
